name: pinned-curobo-v2-consistency
goal: Reach defensible source-compatible cuRoboV2 behavior on Apple Silicon for every classified portable surface.
evaluator_hierarchy: pinned provenance and clean installed-wheel execution
paired CUDA/Metal numerical and exception behavior
device tracing, repeatability, performance, and memory

active_slice.name: foundations-to-kinematics
active_slice.acceptance: Two fresh pinned runs, no nonfinite outputs, no CPU detour, unchanged applicable tests green, paired outputs and VJPs within declared tolerances, critical mutants killed, and full regression green.

explicit_exclusions: raw CUDA and Warp packed ABIs
ROS and unavailable external hardware or datasets
